claims.text: IS, USU starting w glucocorticoids: eosinophilic or giant-cell myocarditis, chronic lymphocytic myocarditis w/o a viral cause, autoimmune, sarcoid (granulomatous) and ICI myocarditis.
claims.quote: Immunosuppression, usually beginning with glucocorticoids, is appropriate for patients with eosinophilic or giant cell myocarditis, chronic lymphocytic myocarditis without a viral cause, myocarditis due to autoimmune disorders, granulomatous myocarditis due to sarcoidosis, and immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) myocarditis

claims.text: Glucocorticoids may also help in SARS-CoV-2 myocarditis.
claims.quote: Glucocorticoids may also help treat myocarditis due to SARS-CoV2 infection
